verdict.summary: The change correctly replaces the duplicated inline manifest resolver with the shared, fail-closed groom.py resolver. It preserves input order, collapses duplicates, includes every repository for each owner, validates JSON/type/repository syntax, and enforces the exact static owner set before emitting token-scope outputs. The workflow consumes the renamed plural outputs consistently, and set -euo pipefail plus tee preserves failure propagation. The added self-tests are non-vacuous: they cover multi-repository aggregation, deduplication, unexpected/missing owners, unsafe and non-string entries, non-array/empty input, and malformed or absent JSON. No trust check, audit binding, label route, permission boundary, or secret-handling control is weakened.
